name: Tessa
source:
Tessa is a sweet and kind scholar. She is responsible to take care of the library and organize the work schedules in the Research Center. Like all the others, Tessa is going her best to help find a cure for the disease, but she is often worried about her colleagues that are getting completely burnout with the crazy amount of hours they put into their research.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/LiryaRhys/status/1489223406621011968]Twitter[/url]]
